title: Music collaboration / social sequence

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Reveal contributions before stating the conclusion so a campaign claim has a visible example behind it.
strategic_value: A music story can make Figma’s teamwork message relevant to an audience beyond product designers.
demonstration: A social-post mockup moves from individual music details and named contributors to a combined guitar-and-boombox illustration, then a campaign end card.
practical_value: Sequence close details, a combined result and a clear closing message in a social format.

content_islands.name: Social container
content_islands.spec: Keep the white social frame on lavender with an orange content field and small interface icons.

content_islands.name: Contributor details
content_islands.spec: Show editing gestures beside labels for Aerosmith, Run-DMC and Rick Rubin.

content_islands.name: Combined image and end card
content_islands.spec: Reveal the full music composition, then replace it with the campaign message and Figma signature.

reference_purposes.Application: The clip presents an illustrated campaign story within a social-post layout.
reference_purposes.Intent: The end card invites viewers to learn about collaboration from musicians.
reference_purposes.Expression: Outlined instruments, colored labels and blue handles carry the identity through the sequence.
